topic: Data update plan for specific advertisers
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on updating production data (prod) with recalculated dataset values (model2) for various client companies, specifically concerning the date range 2025-09-03 to 2025-09-06. Initial analysis showed discrepancies in data for several listed companies, particularly regarding 2025-09-04.

Two main options were discussed: (1) Overwriting prod for all clients and managing potential complaints later, or (2) Only overwriting prod for clients whose calculations matched on 2025-09-03 and 2025-09-05, leaving potentially missing data for the rest.

Later analysis narrowed down companies with measurable differences in metrics (device_session_agg_5) between prod and model2 for 2025-09-04. A final list of companies was identified that showed discrepancies on 2025-09-03 and 2025-09-05 but also had differences on 2025-09-04 (Demo, Innovocean, JCDecaux Côte d’Ivoire, JCDecaux Gabon, JCDecaux India, JCDecaux Latvia, WallDecaux). These specific companies were subsequently moved/updated to prod.
decisions: The decision was made to update production data for a select list of companies that showed discrepancies on 2025-09-03 and 2025-09-05, in addition to those with differences on 2025-09-04.
action_items: The final identified list of companies (Demo, Innovocean, JCDecaux Côte d’Ivoire, JCDecaux Gabon, JCDecaux India, JCDecaux Latvia, WallDecaux) was moved/updated to production.
